english translation text: INTRODUCTORY NOTE\nTHE POET IMAGINES THE CONVERSATION BETWEEN GOD AND THE ANGEL OF DEATH AT THE TIME OF IMAM HUSAYN'S MARTYRDOM

arabic text: KHUDA NE JAB MALAKUL MAUT KO YE IZN DIYA\nKE ROOHE HAZRAT-E-SARWAR NIKAAL KAR LE AA
english translation text: WHEN GOD GAVE THE ANGEL OF DEATH THE ORDER\nTO RETRIEVE THE SOUL OF IMAM HUSAYN (A)

arabic text: RAHE KHAYAAL KE SHABBIR KO NA HO EEZA\nHUSAYN PEHLE HI ZAKHMO SE CHUR CHUR HUA
english translation text: HE TOLD THE ANGEL TO BE MINDFUL NOT TO CAUSE SHABBIR ANY MORE PAIN\nHUSAYN IS ALREADY WOUNDED TO THE POINT OF BEING BROKEN INTO FRAGMENTS

arabic text: MALAK PUKARA YE MUJHSE NA HO SAKEGA KHUDA
english translation text: THE ANGEL OF DEATH REPLIED\nI CANNOT DO THIS DEED MY GOD

arabic text: MAIN KIS TARHA SE NIKALOON BADAN SE JAAN-E-HUSAYN\nBOHAT HI SAKHT HE YA RAB YE IMTEHAN-E-HUSAYN
english translation text: HOW DO I TAKE THE SOUL OF HUSAYN (A) FROM HIS BODY\nMY GOD THIS TRIAL OF HUSAYN IS ALREADY SO DIFFICULT

arabic text: LAGA HAI ZAKHM TABAR BEH RAHA HAI SAR SE LAHOO\nBHARE HAIN KHOON MEIN JAANE RASOOL KE GESU
english translation text: HUSAYN HAS BEEN WOUNDED WITH AN AXE\nBLOOD IS GUSHING OUT OF HIS HEAD\nTHE PROPHET'S SON IS DRENCHED IN BLOOD

arabic text: QAREEB JAAKE RAKHUN DIL PE KIS TARAH QABOO\nKE IS LAHU MEIN TO HAI FATIMA KE DOODH KI BOO
english translation text: HOW DO I KEEP MY HEART AT EASE WHEN I GO NEAR HUSAYN (A)\nWHEN I CAN SMELL THE FRAGRANCE OF FATIMA (A) IN HIS BLOOD

arabic text: MAIN PHIR IN ANKHON PE DHAAOON SITAM YE KYA HAI ZAROOR\nBICHAR KE WO ALI AKBAR SE HOGAYI BE-NOOR
english translation text: HOW CAN I INFLICT PAIN ON HIS EYES\nWHICH HAVING LOST ALI AKBAR HAVE ALSO LOST THEIR SIGHT

arabic text: RIDA YE AAYI DAHAN SE NIKAAL JAAN-E-HUZOOR\nKAHA DAHAN MEIN TO KAANTE PADHE HAI RABBE GHAFOOR
english translation text: CAME THE VOICE LIFT THE SOUL FROM THE BLESSED MOUTH\nHE SAID BUT THERE ARE THORNS IN THE MOUTH O MY FORGIVING LORD

arabic text: NIDA YE AAYI KE GARDAN SE KHAINCH JAAN INKI\nKAHA MEIN KYA KAHU GARDAN PE CHAL RAHI HAI CHURI
english translation text: ALLAH'S CALL WAS TO TAKE IMAM'S SOUL FROM HIS NECK\nTHE ANGEL REPLIED WHAT CAN I SAY THERE IS A KNIFE SLAUGHTERING HIS NECK

arabic text: CHURI PAKAD KE YE CHILLATI HAY KOI BIBI\nNA ZIBHA KAR MERE BACCHE KO MAI DUA DOONGI
english translation text: THERE IS A LADY WHO KEEPS GRABBING THE KNIFE WHILE SCREAMING\nDO NOT SLAUGHTER MY SON I WILL PRAY FOR YOU

arabic text: NIDA YE AAYI KE SEENE SE QABZ KAR LE JAAN\nKAHA WO TEERON SE CHALNI HAY EY MERE REHMAAN
english translation text: ALLAH'S CALL WAS TO TAKE IMAM'S SOUL FROM HIS CHEST\nTHE ANGEL REPLIED HIS CHEST IS FILLED WITH ARROWS OH MERCIFUL LORD

arabic text: ABHI TO MAARKE BARCHI HATA THA EK SHAITAN\nAUR AB TO HAY TANE ZAANU-E-SHIMR YE QURAN
english translation text: JUST NOW ONE SATAN HAS GOTTEN UP FROM HITTING HUSAYN WITH A SPEAR\nAND NOW THIS QURAN (IMAM HUSAYN) IS UNDER SHIMR'S KNEES

arabic text:
RIDA YE AAYI KE MAZLOOMIYAT KE RUTBA SHANAS
KAMAR SE KHAINCH LE SHABBIR KI JAAN BE WASWAAS
KAHA MALAK NE TADAP KAR BADAL DO HASRATO YAAS
KAMAR TO TOOT GAYI JAB SE MAR GAYE ABBAS
english translation text:
CAME THE VOICE O YOU WHO RECOGNIZES THE STAGES OF OPPRESSION
FROM THE SPINE SEIZE THE SOUL OF SHABBIR AND DO NOT HESITATE
CRIED THE SHIVERING ANGEL ALTER YOUR DIVINE WISH
FOR THE BACK WAS SHATTERED WITH THE DEATH OF ABBAS

arabic text:
FALAK SE TAB HUA ROOHUL AMEEN KA INME NUZOOL
KAHA PUKAAR KE MOO DHAANP LO BARAAYE BATOOL
PISAR KI LAASH PE KHOLENGI BAAL BINTE RASOOL
SADA YE THI MALAKUL MAUT KI BA HUZNO MALOOL
english translation text:
THEN FROM THE SKIES THE TRUSTED SPIRIT DESCENDED TO THE ANGEL
HE SAID COVER YOUR FACE O ANGEL FOR THE SAKE OF BATOOL
FOR AT THE CORPSE OF HER SON THE PROPHET'S DAUGHTER WILL GRIEVE
THIS IS WHAT THE ANGEL OF DEATH SAID REPLETE WITH GRIEF AND SADNESS

arabic text: MUTEE-E-HUKM HU PAR FIKR YE HAY AY YAZDAAN\nHAR EK UZR HAY ZAKHMI LAGAUN HAATH KAHAN
english translation text: GOD I AM BOUND BY YOUR ORDER HOWEVER THIS THOUGHT IMPEDES MY ACTION\nEVERY SINGLE BODY PART OF THE IMAM IS WOUNDED WHERE DO I PLACE MY HAND

arabic text: KHUDA PUKARA YE MUSHKIL KARENGE HUM ASAAN\nNA TU NIKAAL MERE AASHIQE GHAREEB KI JAAN
english translation text: GOD REPLIED I WILL EASE THIS DIFFICULT TRIAL\nO ANGEL DO NOT TAKE THE SOUL OF MY POOR OPPRESSED BELOVED SERVANT HUSAYN (A)

arabic text: MAI KHUD NIKAAL RAHA HOON BADAN SE JAAN-E-HUSAYN\nKE KHATM HONE KO AB HAY YEH IMTEHAN-E-HUSAYN
english translation text: I ALLAH MYSELF WILL EXTRACT THE SOUL FROM HUSAYN (A)'S BODY\nSO THAT THIS TRIAL OF HUSAYN (A) CAN COME TO AN END

arabic text:
LAGA HAI ZAQME TABAR BEH RAHA HAI SAR SE LAHOO,
BHARE HAI KHOON MAY JAANE RASOOL KE GAYSOO
KHAREEB JAKE RAKHUN DIL PE KIS TARHA KHABOO,
KE IS LAHOO MAY TO HAI FATEMA KE DOODH KI BOO
english translation text:
HE (A.S) IS SEVERELY INJURED AND BLOOD IS FLOWING FROM HIS HEAD,
THE HAIR OF THE BELOVED OF THE PROPHET IS COVERED IN BLOOD,
HOW SHOULD I CONTROL MY EMOTIONS,
WHEN I CAN SMELL THE FRAGRANCE OF FATIMA FROM HIM
